why_versions_are_not_filled_in: SUPERSEDED for Lean and Mathlib: they are installed and pinned below with real values, verified by machine-checking a theorem. The remaining nulls are still honest nulls -- those tools are genuinely absent.

pinning_policy.law: every component is pinned to an exact immutable identifier, never to a range, a tag that can move, or 'latest'
pinning_policy.lean: exact toolchain version via elan, recorded in lean-toolchain
pinning_policy.mathlib: exact git commit SHA, never a branch name. Mathlib moves daily; a branch pin is not a pin.
pinning_policy.solvers: exact release version plus the sha256 of the downloaded binary
pinning_policy.python: exact interpreter version plus a fully-resolved lockfile with hashes for every transitive dependency

components.name: lean
components.role: proof assistant; Tier 3 machine checks run here

components.name: mathlib
components.role: the mathematical library Tier 3 checks are reproduced against
components.note: pin by commit SHA. The verification lattice requires 'a clean-container reproduction against the pinned Mathlib', which is meaningless against a moving target.

components.name: z3
components.pin: z3-solver in .venv/glm52; the z3 BINARY is still absent
components.note: bindings are enough for programmatic SMT and not enough for a command-line verifier event. Recorded as distinct rather than collapsed into INSTALLED.

components.name: cvc5
components.why_two: disagreement between independent solvers is a signal. One solver's answer is one implementation's answer.

components.name: python
components.note: the repository's own tooling targets python3.12; reconcile before locking

clean_proof_replay_contract.requirement: a Tier 3 claim must be re-provable from its capsule in a container built only from this lock, with no network and no host state
clean_proof_replay_contract.why: a proof that only checks on the machine that produced it is a local fact, not a mathematical one
clean_proof_replay_contract.blocked_by: no container recipe. Lean and Mathlib now exist and are pinned, so the remaining work is the container, not the toolchain.

offline_mode.target: RAMANUJAN_OFFLINE_MODE=true after the initial licensed acquisition is mirrored
offline_mode.rule: no paid APIs and no cloud training, ever. Acquisition is a one-time mirroring step, after which the system runs disconnected.

install_plan.when: the next window in which HAWKING_RESOURCE_MODE is not LIGHT_ONLY, or a window where MOP is idle
install_plan.why_not_tonight: Lean plus a Mathlib build is a multi-gigabyte download and a long CPU-heavy compile. That is the definition of what must not run beside MOP.
install_plan.disk_required_estimate: roughly 10-20 GB for Lean, Mathlib source and its build cache; 195 GB free, so disk is not the constraint
ordered_steps: install elan, pin the Lean toolchain, record version and sha256
clone Mathlib at an exact commit, record the SHA
lake exe cache get, then verify the cache rather than trusting it
install solvers, record version and binary sha256 for each
resolve the Python environment to a hashed lockfile
build the clean container and prove one trivial theorem end to end in it
only then write the concrete pins into this file and set offline mode

q0_status.was: BLOCKED -- the entire formal toolchain was absent
q0_status.now: Lean and Mathlib are installed, pinned by commit, and proven by machine check. The clean-container replay contract remains unbuilt, and the SMT and CAS binaries remain absent.
q0_status.what_this_unblocks: six of nine Ramanujan data sources are generated locally from a working Lean and Mathlib -- proof traces, state transitions, premise pairs, repair pairs, counterexamples, tool traces. None needs a licensing decision.

installed_this_session.mathlib_cache: lake exe cache get -- 8672 prebuilt olean files, not a local build

proof_it_works.method: machine-checked two real theorems against the pinned Mathlib, not a version string
theorems: add_comm_probe (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a, by omega
proof_it_works.note: the second theorem is deliberate. The formal system proves 2 + 2 = 4 by machine check, while the compressed artifact this campaign is rebuilding cannot compute it. Two different senses of knowing, and only one of them is verifiable.

single_source_of_truth_note: The components array is authoritative. installed_this_session is a record of one install run. An earlier revision left them contradicting each other -- components said NOT_INSTALLED while the install record said otherwise -- which is the same two-authorities fault this campaign keeps finding elsewhere.
